steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: ZoTok Workspace Add-on — installed once, lives in every sheet The ZoTok add-on is published in Google Workspace Marketplace. Once installed by the org admin, it appears under Extensions › Zotok for every sheet user with no per-user setup. For Sakku's daily poultry price communication, the coordinator uses Extensions → Zotok → Campaign → Send Messages after updating the 7:30 AM rate sheet; ZoTok selects dealer, wholesaler, and retailer templates, drives WhatsApp engagement, and starts order generation from replies and CTAs.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: One click → 2,480 daily price messages queued ZoTok queues the daily Sakku price broadcast through WhatsApp Business API using pre-approved templates with placeholders replaced from the sheet rows. Campaign codes are detected for EGG-2026-06-01-DEALER , EGG-2026-06-01-RETAILER , and EGG-2026-06-01-WHOLESALER , covering dealers, retailers, and wholesalers in one run.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Broadcast → order capture → dispatch process The dealer starts from the broadcast CTA and ZoAi captures product, tray quantity, location, and delivery date before creating the order and notifying the Sakku sales representative. Final flow: Broadcast → Order Intent → Quantity Capture → Delivery Capture → Order Creation → Dispatch Process .
